summary: adapter.py defines deterministic TDD lifecycle; mandatory Skill input gate before prepare/execute; hidden backend state and shell execution forbidden; declared slice plus nonempty contract/validator hashes required; RED only from prepared with expected failing exit and test/docs paths; GREEN only after observed RED with passing exit and production paths; REFACTOR only after GREEN with passing exit and declared production/test/docs paths; unknown or invalid transitions block with rule diagnostics; candidate requires exact red-green-refactor lifecycle and authorizes nothing; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage bindings require one matching context/attempt, capsule references, shared IDs, nonauthoritative empty decisions; protocol bundle schema rmap.capsule-attempt-bundle.v1; persistence requires complete in-run artifact set, rejects symlinks/reparse points, undeclared files, path escape, and conflicting existing evidence; decisions written after other attempt records; execute rejects existing run directories and requires bundle/store supplied together; recovery document records hashes, IDs, stages, no authorization, optional skill-input hashes; acceptance/handoff/release remain unauthorized
